In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and a [[Unidentified Gotal bounty hunter/Legends|Gotal accomplice]] '''kidnapped''' [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]], the daughters of [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].
